data.narrative:
Stegra is a Growth-stage climate and energy company founded by Carl-Erik Lagercrantz and Harald Mix that has raised $7.0B+ to date. The sector composition includes one public comparable (ticker LNZA) and eight private-sector peers, though a sufficiently narrow peer set at matching stage and valuation tier could not be assembled for direct median benchmarking.

Valuation analysis relies on stage-progression methodology, which applies a typical 1.2x step-up multiplier to the $7.0B total-raised proxy, reflecting advancement within the Growth stage. This method yielded an implied valuation of $8.4B. A peer-median approach was not applicable due to insufficient same-stage and adjacent-stage comparables within the Climate & Energy sector—while eight peers exist in the broader category, none met the screen for narrow-tier matching. The top five private peers identified were Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, and Enovix.

The triangulation analysis, constrained to a single applicable method, supports a valuation range of $7.1B to $9.7B, with a median point of $8.4B. Key uncertainties include the limited comparability dataset, which restricts confidence in peer-derived inputs, and reliance on total-raised as a valuation proxy rather than market-observed transaction multiples. Additional data on recent secondary transactions or late-stage funding rounds would refine this estimate.
